body.statement: There is \(C_d<\infty\) such that \(\sup_{\mathbf P}\mathbb E_{\mathbf P}|\widehat L-L(\mathbf P)|\le C_d[N^{-1/2}+\min\{r/K^2,\ K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\}]\). Relative to Gao--Ge--Qian Theorem 1, the cap improves from \(K^{-1}\) to \(rK^{-2}\), strictly when \(K>d\), and the active high-dimensional term improves from \(K^{-1/2}m^{-2/d}\) to \(K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\).
body.justification: The first theorem-level advance sharpens the published plug-in guarantee using shared squared-sum geometry rather than separate arm envelopes.
body.gap: Gao--Ge--Qian Theorem 1 gives \(N^{-1/2}+\min\{K^{-1},K^{-1/2}m^{-2/d}\}\) when \(d>4\); no located closer paper proves the displayed \(r\)-controlled bound for arbitrary marginals.
body.consumer: The rate determines how much sampling uncertainty must be deducted from an empirical causal lower endpoint.
